title: Find Fibblebrap 1: The Mines
summary: Search the mines for Fibblebrap's gem and deal with Creeper Clicktok.
overview: Search the mines for Fibblebrap's gem and deal with Creeper Clicktok.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Follow the mine objectives and recover the required memory fragment.
For the combat route, hail Creeper Clicktok without carrying the requested larva meat. He becomes attackable after two five-second dialogue delays.
Defeat Clicktok and loot the gem to advance its mission objective.
Complete the pickup and loot objectives before returning through the mission route.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
The peaceful meat-exchange reward branch tests .valid on PLAYER_STARTING_RP, which holds a name string. The published guide covers the hostile dialogue route and gem loot objective instead.
